Name:
⭐ My Darling [V12]
(prod. Eminem)
Notes: Confirmed by Joe Strange to be the intro to King Mathers. Opens with a skit featuring Hailie, Alaina, Stevie, Adam and Nate rummaging through Shady's garage/storage unit. Em does the reference for Dre on the phone call, which was made into backing vocals for the final version. The rest of the song is the same as the release version, aside from the intro synth dropping several decibels when the chainsaw kicks in. The alarm and Em’s "AHH" scream at the end of the intro were later reused at the end of 'Brand New Dance' and in the second verse of 'Antichrist' on TDOSS. The "ohhh shit" line also reappears at the end of 'Dr. West - Skit' for Relapse. Transitions into an unknown track. Leaked the day after SFTL3. Lossless is in circulation.

Notes: Was accidentally released on streaming and on some physical copies and was removed shortly after. Eminem says "Adderall" instead of "Alcohol", has a slightly longer intro & outro, and has different mixing.

Name:
🗑️ Is This Love [V4]
(feat. 50 Cent) (prod. Dr. Dre, Trevor Lawrence Jr. & Mark Batson)
(Sexual Healing)
Notes: Leaked 5 days before release with bad mixing.

(feat. Eminem)
(If I Told You, What If I Was Gay, What If?)
Notes:
OG Filename: What If I Was 2.18
Was being sold on TheSource. Has an alternate Eminem verse. Although it's hard to tell, the song is tagged via an audio watermark either by the leaker or Shady Records themselves. Untagged is in circulation.

Name:
Drips [Clean]
(feat. Obie Trice) (prod. Eminem & Jeff Bass)
Notes: Not a leak since it was included on super early versions of the CD but it is rare and wasnt widely available so thats why it's here. Has funny sound effects to replace the naughty words instead of just the instrumental.

Name: Jessie Reyez - Coffin [V1]
Notes: Version of the song from before Eminem hopped on it.

Notes: Track 1 on side A of the leaked "Under New Management/Cold Room On This Defin' Tape". Also the intro to the title track of Steppin' On To The Scene.

Notes: Skit on "Under New Management/Cold Room On This Defin' Tape".

(Fab Five Freddy)
Notes: Track 5 on side B of the leaked "Under New Management/Cold Room On This Defin' Tape".

Name:
Spider Loc - Do It With Ease
(prod. Eminem & Mike Elizondo)
Notes: Leaked in February 2021. From 2008, unknown what month. Was supposedly the intro to Spider Loc's scrapped "World Wide Web".

Name:
Rihanna - Mothership [V4]
(ref. J. Cole) (feat. J. Cole) (prod. Keyon Christ)
(2 Rihannas, New Rihanna, Mitus Touch)
Notes: J. Cole version of the song which has two verses and a hook with reference vocals for Rihanna. Has a feature on the third verse with lyrics later reused on his 2015 track "Black Friday".

Name:
⭐ Conway the Machine - Bang [V1]
(feat. Eminem) (prod. Daringer, Beat Butcha, Eminem & Luis Resto)
Notes: Lacks the beatswitch, has alternate lyrics and Eminem takes a shot at Revolt, which prompted a response from them on Twitter. Em later apologized publicly. He also pays homage to Mac Miller in the end, R.I.P. Mac Miller. Apparently after this leaked Conway the Machine was unable to use it for his album "God Don’t Make Mistakes".

Name: ⭐ Things Get Worse [V1]
Notes: Leaked in 2019. Likely made on the same day as [V2] (February 10, 2009). Mentions the Chris Brown & Rihanna incident. Eminem references this track leaking in Zeus. This track was later given to B.o.B for his mixtape "EPIC: Every Play Is Crucial".

Name:
Cut Back On My Syllable [V2]
(Cut Back)
Notes:
OG Filename: Cut back 11.27.07
Snippet leaked on November 1st, 2019, and the full song leaked 2 days later. Transitions from Everything I Do into 50 Ways To Kill A Lover.

Name:
Hip-Hop
(Hip-Hop Shop)
Notes: Snippet leaked on November 1st, 2019, and the full song leaked 2 days later. Was previously noted to exist by Koolo and had a chance of leaking in 2011 until it lost in a poll to 'Fly Away.' Likely not the true name of the song. Transitions from an unknown track into 'It's Been Real.' Not to confused with 'Hip Hop' by Bizarre or 'I Am Hip Hop.'

Name:
⭐ Everything I Do [V4]
(prod. Eminem, Luis Resto & Jeff Bass)
(Everything, Everything Freestyle)
Notes: Transitions from I Get Money (Freestyle) into Cut Back On My Syllable. Snippet leaked on October 29th, 2019, and the full song leaked 3 days later. Was shared to users privately on Section Eighty for a few months prior to it leaking. In January 2024, an ASCAP entry for "Everything" appeared with alt names such as "Everything I Do", and "Everything Freestyle". The entry had credits from Eminem, Luis Resto & Jeff Bass. It has since had the credits removed and having "Contact ASCAP for more information" in the credits place.

Name:
🗑️ Joyner Lucas - What If? [V2]
(feat. Eminem)
(If I Told You, What If I Was Gay, What If I Was)
Notes: Confirmed to be called "What If?" by Eminem & Paul on Paul's podcast. CDQ is in circulation.

Name:
Like Toy Soldiers [V1]
(prod. Eminem & Luis Resto)
Notes: Uncensored ("I went through my whole career without ever mentionin' Suge"). Was thought to be fake until proven real much later. The vocals are off-beat due to the acapella not being lined up with the instrumental correctly.

Name:
✨ Nut Up [V4]
(add. Mr. Porter) (prod. Mr. Porter)
(The Ladies)
Notes:
OG Filename: 8.5.09 Nut Up#4
Snippet leaked on January 6, 2011 by Koolo, full song leaked in 2019. Made during the Hawaii sessions for Relapse 2, possibly for the album. Eminem mentioned in October 2009 that the album had 2 songs produced by Mr. Porter, which would be On Fire and this song.

Name:
Luis Resto & John Kachnowski - Melody [V1]
(Fine Line)
Notes: Was reused for Fine Line.

Name:
✨ Kendrick Lamar - Own This City [V3]
(feat. Lauriana Mae)
(Dare To Dream)
Notes: A throwaway from the 'good kid, m.A.A.d city' sessions. Shares same instrumental with Skepta's "Dare To Dream", it's likely that this song became Kendrick's track after Eminem did not release his version.

Name:
🥇 Broke Day [V1]
(feat. Eye-Kyu) (prod. Mr. Porter)
(It's O.K.)
Notes: Has an alternate instrumental. Leaked on the D12 World forums before being put on the fake Infinite snippet tape.

Name:
🏆 Run The Jewels
(Run Your Jewels, Run Ya Jewelz)
Notes: The most wanted Pre-SSLP era Eminem track. Was teased on the D12 World forums before being put on the fake Infinite snippet tape. Seen on a WIP tracklist for an Infinite follow up project.

Name:
Rihanna - Mitus Touch [V5]
(ref. Kanye West & Bibi Bourelly) (prod. Keyon Christ)
(2 Rihannas, New Rihanna)
Notes: Kanye reference track for Rihanna, made while he was executive producing her album ANTI in 2015, sometime after playing her So Help Me God. Has vocals from Bibi Bourelly on the outro. Rihanna would later record over this reference track for her finished vocals, though for some reason Kanye's mumble vocals are used on that version. According to some it was played at a Def Jam meeting and taken for So Help Me God.

Name:
Slaughterhouse - Our House [V1]
(feat. Eminem & Skylar Grey) (perf. Royce Da 5'9", Joell Ortiz, KXNG Crooked & Joe Budden) (prod. Alex da Kid, Johnny Browz, & Luis Resto)
Notes: Leaked by Joe Budden's friend Ice on Twitter. Features a new Joe Budden verse. It's likely Joe's verse was removed by Shady Records since he's said that sometimes when they sent songs over verses would come back removed.

Name:
Skepta - Dare To Dream [V1]
(feat. Lauriana Mae)
(Own This City)
Notes: Skepta's version of Dare To Dream, originally released as a single before being bought by Jimmy Iovine.

Name:
🏆 Dr. Dre - Die Hard [V3]
(feat. Eminem) (prod. Danja & Dr. Dre)
Notes: One of the holy grails of Dr. Dre unreleased tracks, previewed as promotion for “Fight Camp 360º: Pacquio vs. Mosley” in 2011. Specifically promoted as being "from forthcoming album DETOX". Likely edited down from the full version of the song, as it's mostly repetition of Eminem's hook. The song was registered with ASCAP. Likely from late 2010, as Em talked about recording hooks for Detox around that time.

Name:
Young Zee - Spinning Wheels
(prod. Eminem)
Notes: Young Zee song that was produced by Eminem.

Name:
⭐ 50 Ways To Kill Your Lover
(50 Ways, 50 Ways To Kill A Lover)
Notes:
OG Filename: 50 ways to kill a lover 11.2.07
Samples 50 Ways To Leave Your Lover by Paul Simon. Transitions from Cut Back On My Syllable into an unknown song. Samples drums and drum pattern from Peter Tosh, whish were previously used on an unreleased Ca$his and Rikanatti song from 2005. Had Martin L. Gore's 2003 album 'Counterfeit 2' attached to the metadata of the OG file for unknown reasons. The filename was mistitled as "50 Ways To Kill A Lover", but the true song name is "50 Ways To Kill Your Lover."

Name:
⭐ Emulate [V1]
(feat. Obie Trice)
Notes: Originally released on the Anger Management 3 mixtape, but only like half of it. Was later leaked in full and without tags by Koolo. Obie's first verse repeats once, as it was being used as a placeholder while he was still writing a second verse.

Name: ⭐ The Apple [V3]
Notes:
OG Filename: the apple 1.7.2007 / Apple
Leaked by Koolo. The first time Em mentions his tricycle getting stolen as a kid, which wouldn't be brought up again until Leaving Heaven and Higher in 2020 and later Head Honcho in 2024.

Name:
⭐ I Get Money (Freestyle)
(prod. Apex)
(I Get Money (Remix), Get Money)
Notes:
OG Filename: I Get Money Freestyle
Leaked by Koolo. A remix of the 50 Cent song "I Get Money". Mentions 50 Cent's deal with Coca-Cola, his ex-wife and Kanye West. Transitions into Everything I Do. From October/November 2007. Appears to have been re-exported in 2008 (likely for that version of the mixtape).

Name:
⭐ G.O.A.T.
(GOAT)
Notes:
OG Filename: GOAT
Leaked by Koolo. Transitions from It's Been Real and likely the outro to King Mathers. The Paul Wall and Bubba Sparxxx rhyme scheme is a call-back to the intro track, My Darling. The "Raggedy Ann and Andy" bars would later be reused for Underground on Relapse. Recorded at 54 Sound. Snippet leaked on February 15, 2011.

Name: ✨ It's Been Real
Notes: Leaked by Koolo. Transitions from Hip-Hop into G.O.A.T. The song interpolates When I'm Gone. Would've likely been the outro for King Mathers. From November/December 2007. Snippet leaked on January 24, 2011.

Name:
🗑️ Ballin' [V3]
(Ballin' Uncontrollably, Ballin' Do Me)
Notes: Later version of Ballin' Uncontrollably. Likely shares the same first verse as the 2006 version. Eminem references the film 'Superbad' during the outro.

Name:
🗑️ Wee Wee
(Weenie)
Notes: References the film "Zack and Miri Make a Porno". Very nonsensical and all over the place due to it either being a warm up track or him just messing around in the studio. Leaked by Koolo. Snippet leaked on January 23, 2011.

Name:
Going Crazy [V1]
(perf. Eminem, Swifty McVay & Kuniva)
(Fame)
Notes: Recorded in 2010 alongside HMWYBS since D12 was touring with Eminem around that time. Has no tags.

Name:
Things Get Worse [V2]
(feat. B.o.B.)
Notes:
OG Filename: 2.10.09 Things Get Worse With Bob-ASMA_01
Leaked by Koolo and later ended up on Straight From The Lab 2. Has a longer fadeout compared to the released B.o.B. version. The file isn't the OG file, but the original filename was leaked with the song. Snippet leaked on February 20, 2011.

Name:
⭐ Fly Away [V2]
(ref. Just Blaze) (prod. Just Blaze & Nard & B)
Notes:
OG Filename: 3.12.2010 Fly Away
Leaked by Koolo. Just Blaze's vocals were rumored to be a reference for either Kanye West or T-Pain, but Eminem later confirmed them to be a reference for Rihanna, however she never recorded any vocals. Mentions the "Eminem died in car crash" clone theory. Snippet leaked a month before the full song.

Name:
⭐ Here We Go Again
(prod. Dr. Dre)
(Oh No)
Notes: Scrapped Relapse song that was at one point planned to be the opening track. Leaked by Koolo. Snippet leaked a day before the full song leaked.

Name:
🗑️ Detroit Basketball [V21]
(Give Me The Ball)
Notes:
OG Filename: 5.13.08DETROIT BASKET BALL CHUCK -ASMA_21-17
The first song Eminem wrote after getting sober, as said by Em on Paul's podcast. Could have been intended for the Detroit Pistons when they were in the Playoffs at the time the song was recorded. Snippet leaked on January 24, 2011.

Name:
✨ Hit Me With Your Best Shot
(feat. D12) (perf. Eminem, Bizarre, Swifty McVay & Kuniva) (prod. Honorable C-Note)
Notes: Leaked by Koolo. Was teased in a promo image from March 2010. Snippet leaked on January 23, 2011.

Name:
🗑️ Diddy - Dirty Money - Hello, Good Morning (Remix) [V1]
(feat. Eminem) (prod. Danja)
Notes: Shares a line with the Despicable freestyle. Could be from March 2010.

Name:
⭐ Sad Keys
(Difficult, Dudey)
Notes: Leaked by Koolo. A song about Proof. Has open hooks, so it's unfinished. Saved under the name "Sad Keys" likely because it is the name of the beat. There is no true name for this song, as it was just a demo idea never meant for release. Untagged is in circulation.

Name:
✨ Dr. Dre - Topless [V7] 
(ref. Eminem) (feat. Nas & Sly Pyper) (prod. DJ Khalil)
Notes:
OG Filename: 3.20.09 Topless_01
Leaked by Koolo. Eminem's verse is a reference for Dre.

Name:
⭐ Cocaine [V3]
(feat. Jazmine Sullivan) (prod. Salaam Remi)
(Fame, Addicted)
Notes: Snippet leaked on December 22nd, 2010, then a week later the full song leaked by Koolo. Was originally made for Relapse 2 as a single and later developed into Recovery sessions. Said to be intended for a scrapped Recovery expansion as well, however this is unconfirmed. Jazmine Sullivan's hook is often mistaken for Alica Keys.

Name:
⭐ My Syllielable [V3]
(feat. JAY-Z, Dr. Dre, 50 Cent, Stat Quo & Ca$his) (prod. Dr. Dre)
(Happy Birthday, My Syllables, Syllables)
Notes: Leaked by DJ Big Mike. Posse cut making fun of the state of rap at the time. Was mentioned by 50 Cent and Stat Quo in several interviews before it leaked.

Name:
Dr. Dre - I Need A Doctor [V4]
(feat. Eminem & Skylar Grey) (prod. Alex Da Kid)
Notes: Has a slightly different mix. Was meant for both Detox and a scrapped expansion for Recovery. Leaked by Koolo. Untagged is in circulation. From May/June of 2010.

Name:
T.I. - That's All She Wrote [V1]
(feat. Eminem) (prod. Max Martin & Dr. Luke)
(All She Wrote)
Notes: Has a slightly different mix, instrumental, a completely different first Em verse, and lacks T.I.'s final verse. From after May 2010.

Name:
Living Proof [V2]
(prod. Mr. Porter)
Notes: Has very poor mixing, weird autotune on all the hooks, the final hook is censored, and the intro and outro are slightly different. Leaked by Kenny.

Name:
Echo [V3] 
(feat. Liz Rodriguez) (prod. DJ Khalil, Rahki, Bēkon, & Erik Alcock)
Notes: Has an alternate intro and outro, different mixing, alternate verse order, missing vocals from Em and Royce after the first 2 hooks, and Em mentions T.I. instead of Royce at the end of his verse. Leaked by Kenny.

Name:
Lloyd Banks - Celebrity [V1]
(feat. Eminem & Akon) (prod. Dre Montgomery & Dirk Pate)
Notes: Celebrity originally featured Eminem, before his verse was taken off. Only Eminem's verse was leaked, unknown what the other differences are.

Name:
🗑️ Nicki Minaj - I Feel Pretty [V?]
(feat. Eminem) (prod. Swizz Beats)
(Roman's Revenge)
Notes: Leaked in 2010. Has a different hook that was scrapped due to sampling issues.

Name:
✨ Stat Quo - Testify / The Next One
(feat. Eminem) (prod. Eminem) 
(Classic Shit)
Notes: Track #2 on a partial tracklist for Stat Quo's shelved debut album "Statlanta". Leaked as separate tracks, but confirmed to be intended as one by Stat himself. Leaked by Kenny.

Name:
fun. - Jumping The Shark [V1]
(Headlights)
Notes: Headlights was originally a song by fun., performed live in May of 2010.

Name:
Hot Rod - Hate 'Em Or Love 'Em
(feat. Ca$his) (prod. Eminem)
Notes: Hot Rod throwaway featuring Ca$his. Said to be produced by Eminem. Unknown exactly when it's from but it's very likely to be around late 2006-2007 so it'll be here for now.

Name:
Drake - Forever [V8]
(feat. Kanye West, Lil Wayne & Eminem) (prod. Boi-1da)
(I Want This Forever, Bring It Back)
Notes: Has a slightly different mix, instrumental changes and lacks Kanye's "ever ever Mr. West" segment.

Name:
Jazmine Sullivan - Fame [V1]
(prod. Salaam Remi)
(Cocaine, Addicted)
Notes: Leaked in August 2009. Was originally Jazmine Sullivan's song before it was given to Eminem for the song Cocaine.

Name:
⭐ The Warning
(prod. Dr. Dre)
Notes:
OG Filename: thewarning
A direct response to Mariah Carey's song "Obsessed", which was made in response to Bagpipes From Baghdad. This was intentionally leaked by Shady Records and sent to users of Rap Basement forums. The file linked here is the same one they sent to users of the site from the original download link.

Name:
Dr. Dre - I Am Hip Hop [V4]
(ref. T.I.) (feat. Kobe Honeycutt) (prod. DJ Khalil)
(This Is Detox)
Notes: Leaked February 22nd, 2009 with DJ Tags and a day later was dropped without tags. DJ Khalil hinted at being the producer, but couldn't say any info due to pressure from Dre. Interestingly enough, the song leaked under "I Am Hip Hop", which implies that This Is Detox is likely a bootleg title.

Name:
Dr. Dre - Shit Popped Off [V2]
(ref. T.I.) (feat. T.I.) (prod. Wiz The Buchanan)
(Popped Off)
Notes: Reference track for "Shit Popped Off" by T.I., includes a reference verse for Dr. Dre, a different second T.I. verse meant as a feature which went unused, an incomplete hook and no DJ Drama in the intro.

Name:
✨ Dr. Dre - Breaking Bottles [V2]
(feat. Eminem) (ref. Eminem) (prod. Dr. Dre)
(Crack A Bottle, Number One)
Notes: Leaked by DJ Big Mike with tags in December 2008, untagged leaked January 1st, 2009. Em does 2 reference verses for Dre, only one of which was featured on the released version. 50 Cent wasn't meant to be on this version, as confirmed by Em saying "The platinum duo's back on you hoes" rather than "The platinum trio's back on you hoes". Has a different intro vocal take, a different intro screech, a different verse order, less ad-libs, and a worse mix. This was the first song made in the July 2008 Orlando sessions. Leaked under the title "Number One", but discovered to have went by the title "Breaking Bottles".

Name: Fattest Skinny Kid Alive
Notes: Track 2 on the M&M side of the Steppin' On To The Scene EP.

Name: Steppin' On To The Scene
Notes: Track 1 on the M&M side of the Steppin' On To The Scene EP. DJ Butter Fingers has confirmed he owns a copy of the full track.

Name:
Ca$his - 22's [V1]
(prod. Rikanatti)
(22, 22 Clips, 22'z)
Notes: A demo version of the song that leaked out in May 2008. Later appeared on Loose Cannon: The Cut Off.

Name:
Helluva - I Can Be [V2] 
(feat. Eminem)
(Whatever You Want It To Be)
Notes: Was originally T.I. and Eminem's song before it was given to Helluva and remade into I Can Be.

Name:
⭐ Obie Trice - Shady Baby
(feat. Eminem) (prod. Eminem)
Notes: Technically released back in 2007 on Obie's MySpace but it was most likely deleted in the 2016 MySpace incident (where all files up until 2016 were deleted), or before by Obie. Was also played on Shade45 in 2007 and 2008. Obie mentioned it in an interview right after the release of Second Round's On Me and it was scrapped because "everyone’s opinion was that I shouldn’t make that mistake twice" (likely referring to Got Some Teeth).

Name:
Bizarre - Where I'm From
(feat. King Gordy, Young Miles & Kuniva)
Notes: Posted to YouTube on October 29th 2006.

Name:
Trick Trick - Welcome 2 Detroit [V2]
(feat. Eminem) (prod. Eminem)
Notes: Original leaked version, features one line change: "Cheddar Boyz waddup..." instead of "Wonder Boys" (the line was changed due to the killing of Wipeout and Blade). Also has Trick Trick on the first hook (in the release he only appears on the hooks after his first verse). Was later released officially with all the Wonder Boys references removed on "Featuring" by Trick Trick in 2013.

Name:
⭐ Busta Rhymes - I'll Hurt You [V2]
(feat. Eminem) (prod. Scott Storch & Dr. Dre)
Notes: Leaked by Funk Flex. Was meant to appear on The Big Bang but was removed after it leaked. Was also available on a DJ-only promo vinyl.

Name:
Young Zee - We Just Came To Party [V3]
(feat. Eminem) (prod. Red Spyda)
Notes: Leaked in 2004, from 2003. Was for Young Zee's scrapped album that was supposed to release on Shady Records.

Name:
⭐ ???
(prod. Dr. Dre & Mike Elizondo)
(Can-I-Bitch)
Notes: A diss track aimed at Canibus. It's possible the part where Em imitates Dr. Dre is a reference for him. Mentioned in Jenny Watkins' book, "Cleanin' Out My Closet". Unknown if it was made before or after TES released, so it'll stay here for now. Confirmed by Jake Bass to be produced by Mike Elizondo so its likely Dre had a hand too. Snippet leaked on November 20, 2003.

Name:
6 In The Morning [V2]
(perf. Eminem, Swifty McVay, Mr. Porter & Kuniva) (prod. Eminem & Luis Resto)
(Come On in)
Notes: Leaked several months before the release of D12 World with other 'Straight from the Lab' tracks. Later appeared on the DJ Green Lantern mixtape 'Invasion Part III: Countdown to Armageddon' in January 2004. Snippet leaked on November 20, 2003.

Name: ⭐ Bully [V2]
Notes:
OG Filename: Bullymix 12.3.02
A diss track targeted at Benzino and Ja Rule. Intended for Encore. Was originally sequenced toward the start of the album according to Em. Snippet leaked on November 20, 2003.

Name:
Doe Ray Me [V1]
(feat. D12 & Obie Trice) (perf. Eminem, Swifty McVay, Kuniva, Proof & Mr. Porter) (prod. Mr. Porter)
(Doe Rae Me, Hailie's Revenge)
Notes: Similar to the Invasion II version but this version doesn't have tags, has an extended intro, and is much worse quality. In August 2026, Denaun confirmed he produced this song on a stream.

Name:
Love You More [V1]
(prod. Eminem & Luis Resto)
(I Love You More)
Notes:
OG Filename: LoveyouMore idea 12.17.02
Originally leaked on Straight From The Lab before it was released on the deluxe for Encore.

Name: ⭐ Monkey See, Monkey Do
Notes: Was meant for Invasion III before it leaked. Recorded in quarter 4 of 2002.

Name:
We As Americans [V1]
(prod. Eminem & Luis Resto)
(We Are Americans)
Notes: Uncensored ("I'd rather see the president dead"), has a laugh from Em right before the beat drop, lacks all sound effects (except for the one at 2:48), and has a longer instrumental outro. A later version of this song released on the deluxe edition of Encore. This was the last song leaked from Straight From The Lab.

Name:
Trouble Soon [V1]
(prod. The Beatnuts)
(Freestyle, Trouble, Whether Or Not)
Notes: Original version of the song with the Beatnuts instrumental (which couldn't be cleared and got replaced with the Emile-produced instrumental). Leaked by Derty Jason in June 2001. Recorded in early 2001.

Name:
✨ Bitch So Wrong [V1]
(prod. Bass Brothers)
(Bonnie & Clyde Part II, Kim)
Notes: Uncensored at 1:53 ("There's a four year old little boy layin' dead with a slit throat"). Has a slight pitch difference, as well as missing SFX and different vocal takes on the first 2 choruses.
